title:
What makes a good Support Worker? 

The skills you need to be a good support worker can be learned and developed over time. You may already have built up a strong set of transferrable skills from your education, previous roles, and wider life experiences. These can all form a good foundation to build on and develop your career as a support worker

Six key skills are ~

1. Strong communication
2. Adaptability
3. Resilience
4. Emotional intelligence
5. Time management
6. Confidence

Here is one of the tenants we support who said about his Support Worker ~ 

My staff are great, they teach and support me to do things I couldn’t do before!!

#bluepitshousingaction #supportworkers
